sources.name: frontend-design
sources.description: Sets the visual direction for a new or reshaped UI, and names the generated-design tells to avoid. The pack's authority on aesthetic direction.

sources.name: webapp-testing
sources.description: Drives a local web app with Playwright to verify frontend behaviour, capture screenshots, and read browser logs. The pack's browser-verification step.

sources.name: emil-design-eng
sources.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy: component detail, perceived performance, and the invisible polish behind interfaces that feel good.

sources.name: apple-design
sources.description: Apple's interface and fluid-motion approach translated to the web: springs, gestures, interruptible transitions, materials, and optical typography.

sources.name: animate
sources.description: Builds one web animation from scratch in decision order: whether, why, which tool, which properties, curve, duration, interruption, exit.

sources.name: animate-expo
sources.description: The React Native and Expo half of 'animate', using Reanimated, Gesture Handler and expo-haptics. Imported because 'animate' hands native work to it by name.

sources.name: choreograph
sources.description: Coordinates several elements animating together: order, overlap, stillness. Imported because 'animate' owns single animations and defers groups to it.

sources.name: review-animations
sources.description: Reviews a motion diff against the same craft bar, flagging by default. Imported because 'animate', 'choreograph' and 'improve-animations' all point at it by name.

sources.name: improve-animations
sources.description: Surveys a whole codebase's motion and writes prioritized plans without editing source. Imported for reference closure from 'animate' and 'review-animations'.

sources.name: find-animation-opportunities
sources.description: Finds places that should animate and rejects the rest, read-only. Imported because 'choreograph' defers the whether-to-animate question to it by name.

sources.name: remove-animations
sources.description: Subtracts motion an interface does not need. The other half of the whether-to-animate question 'choreograph' delegates, so it is imported with it.

sources.name: pick-ui-library
sources.description: Picks a library for a frontend task from a curated list. Imported because 'animate' stops and invokes it by name when the task needs a component.

sources.name: vercel-react-best-practices
sources.description: React and Next.js performance rules from Vercel Engineering: rendering, re-renders, bundles, server data fetching.

sources.name: vercel-composition-patterns
sources.description: React composition patterns for component APIs that scale: compound components, children over render props, explicit variants, React 19 changes.

sources.name: vercel-react-view-transitions
sources.description: React's View Transition API for route changes, shared elements, enter/exit and list reorder, including the Next.js integration.

sources.name: vercel-react-native-skills
sources.description: React Native and Expo rules for list performance, native UI affordances, navigation, styling and monorepo dependency shape.

sources.name: shadcn
sources.description: Adds, searches, fixes and composes shadcn/ui components, registries and presets, and applies a DESIGN.md or brand spec to them.
